verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents its own built-in AI browser agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, BrowserUse) that take a task through a single API call and can be watched live. HyperAgent's page.ai() also accepts natural-language task delegation. These are API-driven agents for browser tasks, not an in-product assistant the user converses with, and the evidence gives little detail on task scope or results. Missing for 10: an interactive assistant inside the product UI, detailed docs on agent task capabilities and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Hyperbrowser lets you run powerful, AI-driven browser agents in managed cloud sessions. Whether you prefer open-source frameworks or cutting‑edge model-native agents, you can start tasks with a single API call and watch them execute live.
Built in support for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, and BrowserUse agents.
await page.ai("search for flights from Miami to LAX, select the cheapest option");
